target: Frozen 70-conformer mean-open minus mean-closed displacement, projected and normalized in each reference CRBN internal coordinate space; fixed during perturbation.

rotation_null.pivot: TBD centroid projected onto the frozen mean-endpoint screw axis, transported from the anchored mean frame to each reference on residues <=317.
rotation_null.sampling: Uniform unit vectors in an orthonormal three-dimensional internally projected TBD rotation displacement space, using a coordinate-covariant intrinsic rotation frame and the same random coefficients.
rotation_null.interpretation: Descriptive comparison within this local hinge-rotation family; not a biological population p value or all-internal-direction null.

contact.candidate_unit: CRBN author residue x contact class
contact.ridge_loss: Mean squared error plus alpha times squared slope norm; intercept unpenalized.
contact.ridge_target: Exact derivative of log S_flexible with respect to log group spring factor, divided by group contact count.
contact.missing_group_policy: Explicitly absent; never impute a zero effect or count absence as stability.
contact.ranking: Report original stability flags separately from new descriptive rankings in the frozen discovery universe. No predetermined retained candidate count.

claim_gate.primary: Positive R and rotational-null percentile >=95 in all three apo references at 15A, sign retained in 8CVP13/18A and inverse-square models. Rfinite and Rtangent remain separate; finite-closure transfer additionally requires overlap >=0.90.
claim_gate.preservation: M = log S_flexible - log S_isolated >= -1e-7 across primary apo references supports relative specificity preservation, never greater absolute compliance than isolated.
claim_gate.internal_modal_claim: Require separately demonstrated closure-aligned modal/subspace correspondence before describing preserved modal direction as dependent on internal partner deformation.
claim_gate.contact: Descriptive model candidates. Claims beyond tested geometric predictors require adequate held-out comparator support. No post hoc expansion of candidate classes to match known variants.

external.comparison_role: Retrospective structural and observable-specific comparison, including mismatches and unevaluable sites.

excluded_evidence: cryo-EM fitted states that failed the frozen stability criteria
